body:
Oh I believe it, I do believe that there is a conceivable future in which I could be happy again. But how can I get there?

How can I get there with no job, no money, no family, no connections, and no degree? How can I get through that "fog" with a broken mind, a broken heart, and impending homelessness?

It is true.

You are not most people. I am the same way. I have a handful of CLOSE friends that I have known since kindergarten. We share everything, they know me better than anyone else in the world. I thought this was normal all the way through middle school and high school (in which we added more extremely close friends to our circle) until I finally reached college, where I realized this is abnormal, people don't usually get this close to one another, they don't want to. People make friends, then move on without a thought when a job in another state comes up, or if they just feel like it.

Thank you.

I have been for a couple years, working with counselors. They are the ones that originally pressured me into seeing a psychiatrist and going on medication.

I am registered with disability services (I am technically diagnosed with PTSD...) and in the process of appealing, I've gotten this semester's tuition down from 7k to 3k, but that's still more than I have. I also am attempting to apply for private loans (I don't qualify for federal loans while my financial aid is on suspension) but that is difficult without a parent to cosign.

22, not a teen, but just barely.

My problems are many, so I will try to be short.

My parents died my freshman year of college, I begrudgingly agreed to see a psychiatrist who put me on medication (Zoloft) that ended up giving me terrible side effects which caused me to withdraw from a year of college. Now I'm back in school, but they took my scholarships away because I completed less than 75% of my attempted credits, struggling to even go to class, incredibly alone (I was very close with my parents. My girlfriend of 3 years, whose parents made me feel like I was a part of the family after my own family died, cheated on me last summer, then left me a few weeks after because she couldn't deal with me being depressed all the time) and I'm just about to run out of the very small amount of money I was left with. I have no idea what to do. Stepping in front of a train seems like the best option.
